method: Snowball (53855) is admitted appearance-only and rekeyed through the item-stats snapshot. Every pin valid at main's tip and invalidated by that change was replaced with the new digest, iterated to a fixed point. Packets whose content embeds the snapshot digest or a renamed shard path (stack default/historical, timed-item facts, reward-claim variants) were regenerated by their own tools. Pins that no check verifies, historical receipts and archived task records were left unchanged. No validator was changed.
scope: PROF-SNOWBALL-REKEY-1: mechanical re-pin of every live digest that the Snowball admission and items-stats rekey invalidated, including the four D441/2a documents (TibiaWiki-165 historical context, numeric-modifier17 current receipt, stack-default successor8 current-parent receipt v2, stack-default historical native context).
